C. A. 3d Cir. Motions of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until October 22,2012, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
